title: Correctness of a three-sign majority tree
statement: For every input of three signs in $\{-1,1\}$, the decision tree that first queries coordinates $1$ and $2$, and queries coordinate $0$ if those signs differ, returns the sign of the sum of the three input signs, with a nonnegative sum assigned the value $1$.
